project.name: ChronoLog
project.description: A time-ordered shared log with concurrent access and tiered capacity

project.name: Cloud Library
project.description: Cloud Library provided data management and visualization capabilities for cloud-resolving models running on Spark and Hadoop platforms, bridging scientific computing with big data frameworks.

project.name: Coeus
project.description: Accelerating scientific insight by embedding computation in the I/O path

project.name: DeepIO
project.description: I/O methods for scientific AI, from training pipelines to KV cache scheduling

project.name: DEP
project.description: DEP proposed a decoupled execution paradigm that separates compute-intensive operations from data-intensive operations, enabling more efficient utilization of heterogeneous computing resources.

project.name: DiRecMR
project.description: DiRecMR studies differences between map and reduce phases to improve task speculation, resource management, and resilience in MapReduce systems.

project.name: DTIO
project.description: A task-based I/O runtime unifying HPC, Big Data, and ML data stacks through the DataTask abstraction

project.name: FENCE
project.description: FENCE was a hybrid fault-tolerance framework combining proactive fault avoidance with traditional checkpointing to improve resilience in high-performance computing environments.

project.name: GHS
project.description: GHS was a QoS-guaranteed task scheduling system for Grid computing, providing performance evaluation and resource harvesting capabilities. Source code was publicly released (v1.1).

project.name: Hermes
project.description: Distributed buffering across deep memory and storage hierarchies

project.name: HPCM
project.description: HPCM was a heterogeneous process migration middleware enabling legacy code migration across different computing platforms, supporting mobility in high-performance computing environments.

project.name: IDES
project.description: IDES integrates campus microgrid data with high-performance computing, storage, and networking for energy-system analytics and cybersecurity research.

project.name: Integrated Data Management
project.description: This project bridged high-performance computing storage systems (Lustre, PVFS2, GPFS) with big data frameworks (HDFS, MapReduce), enabling unified data management across heterogeneous storage environments.

project.name: IOWarp
project.description: Context management for AI-assisted scientific workflows across heterogeneous storage

project.name: IRIS
project.description: Unified access across file systems and object stores

project.name: LABIOS
project.description: A patented label-based I/O paradigm, rebuilt as an agent I/O runtime for HPC applications and AI agents

project.name: Memory Access Pattern Obfuscation
project.description: This project combines cryptographic algorithms, application requirements, and memory architecture designs to protect memory access patterns from side channels.

project.name: Memory Parallelism
project.description: This project explored memory concurrency across hierarchy layers, developing techniques to exploit parallelism in modern memory systems for improved application performance.

project.name: MPI4AI
project.description: Open MPI communication abstractions for large-scale AI training and inference

project.name: Multicore Scheduling
project.description: This project developed core-aware scheduling algorithms, data access history caching, and prefetching mechanisms optimized for multicore processor architectures.

project.name: OptMem
project.description: Concurrency-aware models and control methods for modern memory hierarchies

project.name: Portus
project.description: Workflow porting and performance tuning with PNNL

project.name: Push I/O
project.description: Push I/O developed a server-push I/O architecture for application-specific optimization, conducted jointly with Argonne National Laboratory and the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

project.name: SMC2 Planning
project.description: SMC2 planning combines near-memory processors and a shared remote memory pool in a system design for graph-mining applications.

project.name: SNOW
project.description: SNOW was a distributed metacomputing platform that enabled scalable computing across networks of heterogeneous workstations, laying the groundwork for later research in distributed systems and process migration.

project.name: SPOTTER-AI
project.description: Provenance and threat attribution for Genesis workflows with Argonne

project.name: StoreHub
project.description: Community findings and a staged design for national data storage research infrastructure

project.name: UniMCC
project.description: Cross-layer support for near-memory processing and disaggregated memory

project.name: VCNS
project.description: VCNS was a sister project of SNOW, providing a virtual collaboratory environment for numerical simulation across distributed computing resources.

project.name: WisIO
project.description: Multi-perspective I/O analysis that connects bottlenecks with root causes

project.name: Workflow
project.description: This project developed scientific workflow management capabilities for Lattice QCD computations on dedicated clusters, conducted jointly with Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory (Fermilab).
